cohort: 421,426 women who gave birth at 127 Illinois hospitals between 2016 and 2018
finding: The study found that severe maternal morbidity significantly underestimates the incidence of maternal complications, and that complicated deliveries have much higher charges and length of stay.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery complications increased 5.9% from 2016 to 2018 and cesarean delivery complications increased 13.8%, while severe maternal morbidity rates remained stable.
